svg.title: Four research directions centered on predictive synthesis
svg.desc: The core is Synthesizability and Synthesis Design: modeling formation pathways to predict and guide synthesis. Structure Evolution and Functional Design provides structural targets and studies material states. Materials for Energy Storage and Conversion provides performance requirements and validates candidate materials. Scientific Agents and Autonomous Research develops enabling tools across these directions. Textual arrows distinguish each relationship. Dotted support connections do not imply a demonstrated autonomous pipeline.
